research_question: Can a bounded label-blind local search over continuous source/filter motor coordinates reduce acoustic reconstruction error and preserve five-vowel identity across already-spent sung and ordinary-speech development voices?

mechanism.continuous_synthesizer: The existing parallel source-filter generator generalized from five table rows to continuous F0/F1/F2/F3 inputs. Formant bandwidths, resonator gains, source tilt, radiation filter, and envelope remain identical to the clean synthetic mechanism.
mechanism.observed_f0: Label-blind autocorrelation pitch estimate over 70-500 Hz; use 110 Hz only when confidence is insufficient.
mechanism.spectral_representation: 20 log-geometric power bands from 200 through 3500 Hz over the full analysis window; add 1e-12, take natural log, subtract the 20-band mean, and L2-normalize.
mechanism.reconstruction_loss: Euclidean distance between observed and synthesized normalized spectral vectors.
mechanism.initialization: Synthesize all five canonical motor plans at the observed F0 and window duration; choose the lowest-loss plan with a/e/i/o/u order as exact tie breaker. No source label enters initialization.

local_adaptation.step_rule: halve every coordinate step after each complete round
local_adaptation.acceptance_rule: accept only a strictly lower loss; retain current value on ties

mechanism.post_hoc_identity: Nearest canonical F1/F2/F3 point using the existing F1/F2 full weight and F3 0.1 weight. Labels enter only after the final motor plan is frozen.
mechanism.reperception: Analyze the final synthesized waveform with the existing LPC perception path and report agreement with the final motor-plan identity.

baselines.fixed_lpc_table: Retain the already-measured current-route identity result for each domain.
baselines.canonical_synthesis_initialization: The pre-adaptation lowest-loss canonical plan from this exact run.

decision_rule: Implement and evaluate only this configuration. A failed gate is retained without a parameter, loss, window, bound, step, round, or synthesizer retry on these examples. Protected confirmation remains unavailable unless every development gate passes and a separate confirmation preregistration is committed.
promotion_boundary: This development run cannot promote H4. A pass only establishes confirmation readiness for continuous inverse synthesis. Motor learning means bounded per-example error-driven parameter adaptation, not acquired human articulation or biological DIVA fidelity.
